dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……はぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Hah... hah..."
dialogues.text: "Hah... hah..."

dialogues.jp: 目を閉じたまま乱れた呼吸を整えていたけど。
dialogues.en: I had closed my eyes as I stopped to catch my breath.
dialogues.text: I had closed my eyes as I stopped to catch my breath.

dialogues.jp:
耳に届く美しい歌声の持ち主を見るために、俺
はゆっくりと目を開けた……。
dialogues.en:
But as a beautiful singing voice reached my ears, my eyes
slowly opened to look at the owner...
dialogues.text:
But as a beautiful singing voice reached my ears, my eyes
slowly opened to look at the owner...

dialogues.jp: ことりが歌っている。暦先生のために。
dialogues.en: Kotori was singing. For Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text: Kotori was singing. For Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、どれだけの想いが込められているん
だろう。
dialogues.en: There was real emotion being put into the song.
dialogues.text: There was real emotion being put into the song.

dialogues.jp:
今まで言葉にしてこなかった……言葉に出来な
かった、暦先生への想い。
dialogues.en:
She couldn't say anything to Koyomi-sensei earlier.. the
things she wanted to tell her.
dialogues.text:
She couldn't say anything to Koyomi-sensei earlier.. the
things she wanted to tell her.

dialogues.jp: 単純に言葉になんかすることが出来なくて。
dialogues.en: She couldn't put it simply in words.
dialogues.text: She couldn't put it simply in words.

dialogues.jp: どれから言葉にしていいのかわからなくて。
dialogues.en: She didn't know what would be right to say.
dialogues.text: She didn't know what would be right to say.

dialogues.jp:
なのに、想いは次から次へと溢れてきて、胸を
締めつけるから。
dialogues.en: So, she put all the emotions she felt in her chest.
dialogues.text: So, she put all the emotions she felt in her chest.

dialogues.jp: ことりは歌に託す。
dialogues.en: And entrusted them into her song.
dialogues.text: And entrusted them into her song.

dialogues.jp:
今まで、好きじゃないと思い込んでいた、本当
は好きな歌に。
dialogues.en:
She may have gotten the impression that she didn't like
singing, but this made me certain that she really does love
it.
dialogues.text:
She may have gotten the impression that she didn't like
singing, but this made me certain that she really does love
it.

dialogues.jp: 歌詞に意味はなくて。
dialogues.en: It's not a matter of the lyrics.
dialogues.text: It's not a matter of the lyrics.

dialogues.jp: メロディーにも意味はなくて。
dialogues.en: Nor one of the melody.
dialogues.text: Nor one of the melody.

dialogues.jp: たぶん、きっと。
dialogues.en: Instead.
dialogues.text: Instead.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが暦先生のために歌っている。それが一
番重要なんだ。
dialogues.en:
It's the fact that Kotori is singing this for Koyomi-sensei.
That's the most important part.
dialogues.text:
It's the fact that Kotori is singing this for Koyomi-sensei.
That's the most important part.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは暦先生をジッと見つめて。暦先生もこ
とりをジッと見つめていて。
dialogues.en:
Kotori didn't take her eyes off Koyomi-sensei, and
Koyomi-sensei returned the favour.
dialogues.text:
Kotori didn't take her eyes off Koyomi-sensei, and
Koyomi-sensei returned the favour.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの歌声が、ふたりをそっと、優しく包み
込んでいた……。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's singing was gently wrapping the two of them
together...
dialogues.text:
Kotori's singing was gently wrapping the two of them
together...

dialogues.jp: ことりの歌が終わる。
dialogues.en: Kotori's song then ended.
dialogues.text: Kotori's song then ended.

dialogues.jp:
最初は小さな拍手がさざ波のように起こり、次
第に大きくなっていく。
dialogues.en:
There was a light applause it first, quickly followed by
raucous clapping.
dialogues.text:
There was a light applause it first, quickly followed by
raucous clapping.

dialogues.jp:
オープンタイプの結婚式場だったので、列席者
だけじゃなく、通りすがりの人たちも拍手をし
ていた。
dialogues.en:
The wedding ceremony was one of those open-types, so it
wasn't just the attendees, but people passing by who were
clapping too.
dialogues.text:
The wedding ceremony was one of those open-types, so it
wasn't just the attendees, but people passing by who were
clapping too.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "E, ehm..."
dialogues.text: "E, ehm..."

dialogues.jp: あまりの拍手に戸惑うことり。
dialogues.en: Kotori seemed lost at what to do about the clapping.
dialogues.text: Kotori seemed lost at what to do about the clapping.

dialogues.jp: その様子が可愛らしくて微笑んでしまう。
dialogues.en: I smiled at her cute reaction.
dialogues.text: I smiled at her cute reaction.

dialogues.jp:
「手を挙げるなりなんなりして、応えるもんだ
　ぜ？」
dialogues.en: "At least respond by raising your hand, eh?"
dialogues.text: "At least respond by raising your hand, eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、そうでもしないとおさまらないぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't let them leave unsatisfied, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Don't let them leave unsatisfied, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……えっと、それじゃあ」
dialogues.en: "...Erm, then..."
dialogues.text: "...Erm, then..."

dialogues.jp:
どうも〜、と言った感じで、ことりが手を振る
と。
dialogues.en: Thank you~, she said, as she waved her hand.
dialogues.text: Thank you~, she said, as she waved her hand.

dialogues.jp: 一層拍手が大きくなった。
dialogues.en: The applause grew even louder.
dialogues.text: The applause grew even louder.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何か逆効果だったみたいだけど……」
dialogues.en: "That sort of backfired..."
dialogues.text: "That sort of backfired..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、あれだ。それだけ、ことりの歌がみん
　なの心を動かしたってことだ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh well, that's how it is. Your song was so moving, it
touched everyone's hearts."
dialogues.text:
"Oh well, that's how it is. Your song was so moving, it
touched everyone's hearts."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん、俺もそのひとりで」
dialogues.en: "Of course, it did so for me as well."
dialogues.text: "Of course, it did so for me as well."

dialogues.jp: ことりの後ろを目線で示す。
dialogues.en: Kotori gazed at me, beaming.
dialogues.text: Kotori gazed at me, beaming.

dialogues.jp: 「そこに、もうひとり」
dialogues.en: "And, another."
dialogues.text: "And, another."

dialogues.jp:
拍手と人波を｛か／掻｝き分けて、ドレス姿の暦先生が
駆け寄ってきた。
dialogues.en:
Standing among the crowd, the wedding dress-clad
Koyomi-sensei rushed towards Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Standing among the crowd, the wedding dress-clad
Koyomi-sensei rushed towards Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ことり……っ！」
dialogues.en: "Kotori...!"
dialogues.text: "Kotori...!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃん……」
dialogues.en: "Onee-chan..."
dialogues.text: "Onee-chan..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ことりには、言いたいことがたくさんあるん
　だ」
dialogues.en: "There's a lot I want to say to you..."
dialogues.text: "There's a lot I want to say to you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……うん。そうだね。私、怒られるようなこ
　と、しちゃったからね」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, you do. That you're angry with me, and..."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, you do. That you're angry with me, and..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「違う、違うよ」
dialogues.en: "That's not true!"
dialogues.text: "That's not true!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「違わないよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes it is..."
dialogues.text: "Yes it is..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃんの一生に一度の結婚式なのに、逃
　げ出して。すっごい心配かけて……」
dialogues.en:
"I ran away from your once-in-a-lifetime wedding ceremony,
and made you so worried..."
dialogues.text:
"I ran away from your once-in-a-lifetime wedding ceremony,
and made you so worried..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「バカッ！」
dialogues.en: "Stupid!!"
dialogues.text: "Stupid!!"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の強い口調が、ことりの頬を叩く。呆然
とした表情で、ことりが暦先生を見る。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei said fiercely. Kotori, with an astounded
expression on her face, looked towards Koyomi-sensei again.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei said fiercely. Kotori, with an astounded
expression on her face, looked towards Koyomi-sensei again.

dialogues.jp: 暦先生はことりの肩を掴んだ。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei held Kotori's shoulders tightly.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei held Kotori's shoulders tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そんなこと気にしないで。そんなこと、どう
　だっていいんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about that. I don't care about that..."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about that. I don't care about that..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あたし……あたしは……」
dialogues.en: "All I care about is that..."
dialogues.text: "All I care about is that..."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生のまなじりに、涙がにじみ始める。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei's tears started flowing in mid-sentence.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei's tears started flowing in mid-sentence.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ことりが……ここ……ここに来て……」
dialogues.en: "That you... came here..."
dialogues.text: "That you... came here..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしのために……歌って……くれたのが嬉
　しくて……」
dialogues.en: "And sang... for me... made me happy..."
dialogues.text: "And sang... for me... made me happy..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「もうとにかく嬉しくて……だから…………だ
　から………………」
dialogues.en:
"So happy that I can't describe it... that's why... that's
why........."
dialogues.text:
"So happy that I can't describe it... that's why... that's
why........."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃん……」
暦先生がことりを思いっきり抱きしめた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei hugged Kotori tightly.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei hugged Kotori tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとう、ことり。……ほんとに、ありが
　とう……」
dialogues.en: "Thank you Kotori... thank you so much..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you Kotori... thank you so much..."

dialogues.jp:
最後の言葉は、ほとんど涙になっていて聞こえ
なかったけど。
dialogues.en:
With those final words, the only sound that could be heard
after was crying.
dialogues.text:
With those final words, the only sound that could be heard
after was crying.

dialogues.jp:
それでも、ことりにはしっかりと届いたみたい
だった。
dialogues.en:
Her emotions seem to have gotten through to Kotori, at
least.
dialogues.text:
Her emotions seem to have gotten through to Kotori, at
least.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃん……」

ことりのまなじりにも、光り輝くものがあった
から……。
dialogues.en: Something in Kotori's eye was sparkling as well...
dialogues.text: Something in Kotori's eye was sparkling as well...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃん、私、お姉ちゃんのこと、大好き
　だよ……」
dialogues.en: "Sis, I really love you..."
dialogues.text: "Sis, I really love you..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あたしだって……あたしだって大好きだ」
dialogues.en: "Me too... I really love you too..."
dialogues.text: "Me too... I really love you too..."

dialogues.jp:
抱きしめ合ったふたりの上に、優しい拍手の雨
が降り注いだ。
dialogues.en:
The rest of us clapped lightly at the beautiful scene before
us.
dialogues.text:
The rest of us clapped lightly at the beautiful scene before
us.

dialogues.jp: ◆結婚式の歌姫◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Singing Princess of the Wedding Ceremony◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Singing Princess of the Wedding Ceremony◆

dialogues.jp: 結婚式場にことりの美しい歌声が響き渡った。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's beautiful singing voice echoed around the wedding
ceremony.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's beautiful singing voice echoed around the wedding
ceremony.

dialogues.jp:
今まで言葉に出来なかった、暦先生への思いが
込められた優しい歌声だった。
dialogues.en:
There was no need for words. Everything that she wanted to
convey to Koyomi-sensei was in her gentle song.
dialogues.text:
There was no need for words. Everything that she wanted to
convey to Koyomi-sensei was in her gentle song.

dialogues.jp:
鳴り止まない拍手の中、抱きしめあうことりと
暦先生。二人のまなじりに光り輝く涙がとても
印象的だった。
dialogues.en:
In the middle of the unending applause, the two of them
embraced, tears falling from their eyes.
dialogues.text:
In the middle of the unending applause, the two of them
embraced, tears falling from their eyes.
